description: ENCODEURL -- RFC 3986 percent-encoding with uppercase hex (Excel 365 Mac ja-JP)

cases.skipped: Mac Excel 365 ja-JP does not register ENCODEURL (#NAME? on every probe). Formulon implements the documented RFC 3986 percent-encoding correctly; verified against Microsoft's documentation.
Mac Excel 365 ja-JP does not register ENCODEURL (#NAME?). Formulon: "a/b c?d=1&e=2" -> "a%2Fb%20c%3Fd%3D1%26e%3D2".
Mac Excel 365 ja-JP does not register ENCODEURL (#NAME?). Formulon: RFC 3986 unreserved set passes through verbatim.
Mac Excel 365 ja-JP does not register ENCODEURL (#NAME?). Formulon: "日本語" -> "%E6%97%A5%E6%9C%AC%E8%AA%9E" (UTF-8 byte expansion, uppercase hex).
Mac Excel 365 ja-JP does not register ENCODEURL (#NAME?). Formulon coerces TRUE -> "TRUE" then percent-encodes -> "TRUE" (all unreserved).
Mac Excel 365 ja-JP does not register ENCODEURL (#NAME?). Formulon: "" -> "" (empty input passes through).
Mac Excel 365 ja-JP does not register ENCODEURL (#NAME?). Formulon: "100%" -> "100%25" (percent itself is reserved).
